dedupe_keys.name: stochastic ac optimal power flow for wind and solar hosting capacity analysis on the ieee 39 bus system

description: The AC optimal-power-flow research team publishes simulation code and results for wind and solar hosting analysis on the IEEE 39-bus New England test system. Zenodo provides one archive under CC BY 4.0. The described model uses differential evolution with feasibility rules to select generator active powers and voltage magnitudes. Wind and solar injections use Weibull and Beta distributions at two weak buses, with curtailment as a decision variable. The package compares metaheuristics, a deterministic baseline checked against GAMS/IPOPT, stochastic ensembles, penetration sweeps and inverter reactive support. These files can benchmark renewable-hosting and voltage-control scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this implementation. Coverage is one modified test system, not the operating New England grid. A limitation is that distribution choices and siting at only two buses constrain transfer, while a solver reference check does not establish field validation. No archive was downloaded and no optimisation objective or voltage limit was independently recalculated.
